mechanics.claim: Spell Shield blocks the next hostile effect and heals Sivir plus grants a move speed buff only if it successfully blocks something.
mechanics.quote: Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, she {{tip|heals}} herself and activates ''{{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}}''

mechanics.claim: The shield can still block delayed area-of-effect damage from an ability already applied to Sivir before the shield was up.
mechanics.quote: ''Spell Shield'' will still block abilities that have already been applied to '''Sivir''' if the delayed effects of that ability is [[area of effect]]
